notes: The motor page's Lift-it numbers on the PUBLIC composition path (electromechanical v1). Hand-derived before the first run: R_tot = 2 + 0.05 ohm; tau = m g r = 0.1 x 9.80665 x 0.04 = 0.0392266 N m; J_eff = 5e-4 + 0.1 x 0.04^2 = 6.6e-4 kg m^2. Steady state V = R i + K w, K i = b w + tau: w_ss = (K V - R tau)/(K^2 + R b) = (1.8 - 0.0804145)/0.09205 = 18.681 rad/s; i_ss = (b w_ss + tau)/K = 0.19303 A. Mechanical lag J_eff R/(K^2 + R b) = 14.7 ms, so theta(0.6) ~ 18.681 x (0.579 - 0.0147) = 10.54 rad and the rack height r theta ~ 0.4217 m. The shaft is braked at rest until 20 ms; a brief sag while the current builds after release is the page's known dip (graced 5 ms, reported).
